id: title:Gilbert09:retry the external data job insert on a postgres deadlock

review.posthog_relevance: Adds database deadlock handling and retry mechanism for ExternalDataJob INSERT operations, potentially preventing lost job creation or duplicate rows.
review.reason: Adds a retry decorator and a test for deadlock handling around an ExternalDataJob INSERT. While the implementation is not supplied, the addition of the retry decorator and the test for deadlock handling indicates a substantive, bounded capability improvement. This could prevent lost job creation or duplicate rows if the implementation is correct.
